sn56.41:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe || || 2.
sn56.41:1.3: Bhūtapubbam bhikkhave aññataro puriso Rājagahā nikkhamitvā Lokacintaṃ cintessāmī ti yena Sumāgadhā pokkharaṇī tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Sumāgadhāya pokkhariṇiyā tīre nisīdi lokacintaṃ cintento || || 3.
sn56.41:1.4: Addasā kho bhikkhave so puriso Sumāgadhāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre caturaṅginiṃ senam bhisamūḷālam pavisantiṃ ||
sn56.41:1.6: Ummatto smi nāmāhaṃ viceto smi nāmāham ||
sn56.41:1.7: yaṃ loke natthi tam mayā diṭṭhan ti || || 4.
sn56.41:2.1: Atha kho so bhikkhave puriso nagaram pavisitvā mahājanakāyassa ārocesi ||
sn56.41:2.2: Ummatto smi nāmāham bhante viceto smi nāmāham bhante ||
sn56.41:2.3: yaṃ loke natthi tam mayā diṭṭhan ti || ||
sn56.41:2.4: Katham pana tvam ambho purisa ummatto || kathaṃ viceto ||
sn56.41:2.5: kiñca loke natthi yaṃ tayā diṭṭhan ti || || 5.
sn56.41:2.6: Idhāham bhante Rājagahā nikkhamitvā Lokacintaṃ cintessamī ti yena Sumāgadhā pokkaraṇī tenupasaṅkamiṃ || upasaṅkamitvā Sumāgadhāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre nisīdiṃ lokacintaṃ cintento ||
sn56.41:2.7: addasaṃ kho ham bhante Sumagadhāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre caturaṅginiṃ senaṃ bhisamūḷālam pavisantiṃ ||
sn56.41:2.8: evaṃ khvāham bhante ummatto evam viceto
sn56.41:2.9: idañ ca loke natthi yam mayā diṭṭhan ti || ||
sn56.41:2.10: Taggha tvam ambho purisa ummutto || taggha viceto ||
sn56.41:2.11: idañ ca loke natthi yaṃ tayā diṭṭhan ti || || 6.
sn56.41:3.1: Taṃ kho pana bhikkhave so puriso bhūtaṃ yeva addasa no abhūtaṃ || ||
sn56.41:3.3: tasmiṃ kho pana bhikkhave saṅgāme devā jiniṃsu asurā parājiniṃsu ||
sn56.41:3.4: parājitā ca kho bhikkhave asurā bhītā bhisamuḷālena asurapuram pavisiṃsu devānaṃ yeva kho bhāyamānā || || 7.
sn56.41:4.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave mā lokacintaṃ cintetha ||
sn56.41:4.2: Sassato loko ti va Assassato loko ti va || Antavā loko ti vā Anantavā loko ti vā || Taṃ jīvam taṃ sarīranti vā Aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran ti vā || Hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā ti vā || Na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā ti vā || Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā || Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā || ||
sn56.41:4.4: Nesā bhikkhave cintā atthasaṃhitā nādibrahmacariyikā na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati || || 9.
sn56.41:5.1: Cintentā ca kho tumhe bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhan ti cinteyyātha || la || Ayam dukkhanirodhagāminī patipadā ti cinteyyātha || ||
sn56.41:5.3: Esā bhikkhave cintā atthasaṃhitā esā ādibrahmacariyikā esā nibbidāya virā- ni- upa- abhi- sambo- nibbānāya saṃvattati || || 11.
sn56.41:6.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la-[pe] || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo
